summary: News Corp filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing daily repurchase information provided to the ASX under its existing $1 billion stock buyback program. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure, not a new capital return event. The filing does not announce a tender offer, special dividend, or any structural change. The company reaffirms its ongoing authorization to repurchase shares from time to time, with no specific terms, price, or timeline provided beyond the existing program. This is a standard update for Australian listing requirements. No actionable special situation is present.
